# Bootstrap Summary: SEI Assessment Coach

**Date**: 2026-04-18  
**Generated by**: /bootstrap command

## Interview: Questions & Answers

### Project Basics

- **What does your app do?** SEI Assessment Coach is the AI Assessment & Strategy Agent: an internal Guide experience that helps SEI consultants learn the AI Assessment product through a teaching conversation, ending in a structured learning summary (not a sales scorecard).
- **Who are the users?** Internal SEI consultants (learners).
- **#1 problem solved?** Structured, consistent practice and reflection on AI Assessment positioning without building a separate training stack from scratch.

### Platform & Scale

- **Platform**: Web app (Next.js).
- **Year 1 users**: Assumed low internal usage (&lt; 100) unless stated otherwise.
- **Specific requirements**: Voice (ElevenLabs) and text; session time limit for demo; learning summary with confidence and dimension cards.

### Integrations & Data

- **Payments**: No.
- **Emails/notifications**: Not required for MVP (can add later for invites).
- **Integrations**: Anthropic (summary generation), ElevenLabs (voice), optional OpenAI embeddings and Supabase if RAG is wired as in the reference architecture.
- **Data types**: Session and onboarding context (localStorage and/or DB as implemented); agent prompts via backend; transcripts for summarization.

### Business Context

- **Timeline**: MVP-style delivery; ship core flow before polish.
- **Team**: Small team; favor maintainable defaults.
- **Budget**: Prefer managed hosting and usage-based AI APIs appropriate to internal traffic.

### Branding & Design Guidelines

- **Guidelines provided?** Inherited SEI family direction (dark plum, gradients, Lang Gothic) documented in `CLAUDE.md`; no separate style guide file in this run.
- **Details**: Align with internal Guide look and feel; finalize tokens when design signs off.

### Linear Project Setup

- **Create Linear project?** Not created in this run (no Linear MCP project tool in session). Create or link a project manually when ready.
- **Project name**: Suggest "SEI Assessment Coach" or match this workspace name.

## Technical Decisions Made

| Decision | Choice | Business Reasoning |
|----------|--------|-------------------|
| Framework | Next.js App Router 14.x | Same pattern as the reference SEI app; fast iteration, straightforward deployment, strong hiring pool. |
| Database | Supabase + Prisma when needed | Matches org stack; add schema when features require persistence beyond local session storage. |
| Hosting | Azure App Service (target), Vercel for dev/staging | Production target is SEI Azure environment; Vercel for local and staging only until Azure is ready. |
| Authentication | NextAuth v5 + Azure AD (Entra ID) | All routes protected by middleware; users authenticate with SEI Microsoft credentials. No STUB_USER_ID anywhere in the codebase. Required before any PR to sei-org. |
| Knowledge Provider | Abstraction layer (Supabase default, Azure stub) | `lib/knowledge/` interface allows swapping data source via `KNOWLEDGE_PROVIDER` env var. Ships on Supabase; Azure data source wired in when ready. No app-layer changes required at swap time. |
| Payments | None | Not in scope. |
| Emails | None for MVP | Reduces scope until there is a business trigger. |

## Timeline & Cost Estimates

- **MVP**: Approximately 4-6 weeks for onboarding, session (voice + text), summary API, and production config — assuming parallel with porting from the reference repo.
- **Monthly hosting (Year 1)**: Roughly \$0-\$50/month for typical internal usage plus metered AI and voice.
- **Key milestones**: Specs in place; core routes; env and agents configured; UAT on staging.
